messages:
sam: Quick heads-up: planning to make /api default to v2 next Tue 03:30 UTC. Want to lock a run plan and explicit rollback triggers. Requesting operator eyes and pinlist.

deploybot: Scheduled rollout run_id=20260331-03-30-8001112222. Canary steps: 2% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100%. Step delay=180s. Auto-rollback supported. Use --dry-run to preview.

devon: Heads-up from Integrations: a small set of partners rely on deprecated `x-version` header and will 422 on v2. Please add partner tenants to pinlist: p-88,p-99.

alice: QA found a memory growth pattern on v2 when requests include long-context + embeddings. Risk: node OOM after ~15k tokens. Suggest enabling `max_context=8k` for canary and watch resident mem.

prod-ops: Runbook note: rollback command: `deploybot abort --run 20260331-03-30-8001112222 --stage immediate` or `curl -XPOST https://deploy-api.internal/runs/8001112222/abort`. Notify partners channel on rollback.

sam: Add thresholds: abort if node OOM events > 1 within 10m OR 5xx rate > 1% sustained for 3m OR canary p99 latency regresses by >50% vs baseline. Also abort if pinned-tenants > 4% of traffic on preflight.

alice: I'll set a temporary header-gate for canary: require `x-api-canary: yes` for canary traffic so we can route manually if needed. Also enabling `--warm-cache=true` to avoid cold-kv spike.

devon: Partners pinned. I'm sending them migration docs + SDK snippet for header change and fallback: https://internal.docs/partners/v2-migrate.

deploybot: Pinlist applied: p-88,p-99; mobile_legacy=true; partner_streaming=true. Window 03:30-06:30 UTC. Auto-rollback triggers configured per sam's thresholds.

prod-ops: Ops-eyes scheduled 03:10 UTC. I'll watch process RSS, 5xx, and canary p99. If abort happens, I'll coordinate incident channel and tenant comms.

sre-oncall: I'll be on standby. Muted low-signal alerts; kept OOM, pod restarts, and p99 spikes enabled. If memory grows > 70% of container limit, consider immediate stepback.

sam: OK locking window barring objections. Final checklist: deploybot run_id present, pinlist in place, docs updated, ops-eyes, rollback runbook linked. Proceed unless someone objects today.

alice: No objections from infra.

devon: Partners notified.

sam: Thanks all. We'll proceed with the scheduled run. If anything unexpected, trigger the abort command and loop in @sre-oncall and @prod-ops.
